_notes: Template. Copy to <project>/.omp/mcp.json (project servers) or ~/.omp/agent/mcp.json (global). Replace every <PLACEHOLDER>.

Never put a real token in this file. OMP resolves a bare env-var name in an stdio `env` block from its own process environment at connect time: the value is the NAME of a shell variable, not the secret.
Export the variables in the shell BEFORE you launch OMP. A variable exported after OMP started stays invisible; relaunch OMP, do not just reload MCP.

azure-devops: authenticates with a scope-limited Personal Access Token (-a pat). The variable must hold base64(':' + PAT), the Basic credential form, not a raw PAT. Scope the PAT to what the workflow needs (work items, code, build, test, wiki). No `az login` is needed for this server.
azure-mcp: uses your Azure CLI / default Azure credential. Run `az login --tenant $CLIENT_AZURE_TENANT_ID --subscription $CLIENT_AZURE_SUB_ID_AI_DEV` first (see rules/project/azure-cli-fallback.md).
playwright: browser automation. The --secrets file holds the E2E test user credentials (TEST_USER_USERNAME, TEST_USER_PASSWORD, TOTP seed). Keep it outside git. Agents must never read or print it.

slack: community server korotovsky/slack-mcp-server over stdio, user OAuth token (xoxp). SLACK_MCP_ADD_MESSAGE_TOOL=true registers the write tool; leave it unset for read-only. Create the Slack app from a manifest with user-token scopes: channels/groups/im/mpim history and read, chat:write, search:read, usergroups:read/write, channels:write.
Tool approval for these servers is set in harness/project/config.yml (tools.approval and toolApprovalConditions).
